mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3.5% in a given month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the unemployment rate and increases in payroll employment growth signal labor market overheating that triggers central bank tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime defined by housing starts above 1500 thousand units, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and impending economic slowdown, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and residential sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, preceding rising equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase defined by unemployment rate below 4.0% and payroll employment growth above 0.5% monthly, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns as corporate hiring supports earnings growth, leading to positive 5-day returns.
regime_hint: labor market recovery (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%)
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the labor market recovery condition (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%).
